note: Rewritten from Krishna 1961; original in English; in table 2 (soldier) the mean printed for the row of maximum postmentum width is 0.49 (equal to the upper limit of the range and probably missing a digit in the OCR), so that mean is left blank with "—"; all other values are transcribed verbatim.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: All measurements of the alate are greater than in B. spinicollis and B. exsertifrons. The soldier differs from B. spinicollis in that the latter is smaller, has shorter mandibles, less projecting lateral frontal lobes, a less concave middle of the frontal region, smaller eyes, a differently shaped postmentum and more broadly rounded posterolateral corners of the pronotum; it differs from B. exsertifrons in that the latter is smaller, has the front of the head reddish brown, a deeper and narrower median depression between the frontal lobes, and a pronotal anterior margin with a deeper notch, fewer serrations and not projecting.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, paler behind the eyes; ocelli white; eyes black; postclypeus smoky brown, darker than the head; anteclypeus white; labrum yellow; pronotum yellow, concolorous with the labrum or slightly darker; tibiae pale yellow; antennae and femora brownish yellow; wing scales yellowish brown; wing membrane clear and transparent, slightly brownish; costal area yellowish brown, with five or six cubital branches near the wing scale tinged brown; abdominal sternites brownish yellow; tergites pale yellow. Head with a few scattered short setae; margins and lobes of the pronotum with long or short stiff setae; anterior margins of the fore and hind wings with short hairs. Frons sloping slightly towards the anteclypeus; sides of the anteclypeus straight, converging anteriorly, anterior margin straight or slightly concave. Eyes large, moderately projecting, lower margin not far from the lower margin of the head, anterior margin straight. Ocelli almost oval, touching the eyes. Antennae 14—15-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3 or 4, segments 3 and 4 nearly equal in length. Pronotum transversely arched, narrower than the head, anterior margin concave with a median incision, sides rounded, converging posteriorly, posterolateral corners broadly rounded, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Wing membrane reticulate, with faint papillae. Forewing subcosta single; radius long and unbranched; radial sector with 6—7 branches; cubitus with 13—14 branches; hind wing radial sector with 5—6 branches. Tibial spurs 3:3:3; arolium absent. Measurements (mm; range/mean of 8 alates): head length to the tip of the labrum 1.52—1.68/1.58; head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.10—1.22/1.16; head width 1.25—1.28/1.27; eye diameter 0.47—0.59/0.53; lower margin of the eye to the lower margin of the head 0.06—0.12/0.09; ocellus length 0.10—0.13/0.12; median pronotum length 0.61—0.70/0.65; maximum pronotum length 0.70—0.79/0.73; pronotum width 1.04—1.10/1.08; hind tibia length 0.98—1.10/1.05; forewing length from the suture 10.15—10.72/10.37; forewing width 2.82—2.91/2.84; forewing scale length 0.98—1.07/1.05.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Posterior part of the head brown, grading forwards into reddish brown and almost black in front; mandibles dark reddish brown; labrum reddish brown; pronotum yellow, brown on the anterior elevation; legs and antennae pale brownish yellow. Head sparsely covered with minute setae; pronotum moderately densely covered with setae of various sizes. Head short and truncate; sides straight in front of the eyes, converging anteriorly to the lateral base of the mandibles; frontal region coarsely wrinkled; lateral frontal lobes projecting as conspicuous round lobes, the area between them depressed and sloping down towards the anteclypeus; lateral frontal angles extending forwards as horizontal projections connected with the dorsal margin of the antennal sockets; another conspicuous horn-like projection below and in front of the antennal socket. Eyes large, unpigmented. Antennae 12—13-segmented, segment 3 nearly equal in length to segment 2 or 4. Mandibles short, broad at the base, curved towards the apex, with a conspicuous basal ridge; left mandible with 3 not very projecting marginal teeth, the posterior edge of the first marginal tooth and the anterior edge of the second meeting to form a concave cutting edge, the concave cutting edge between the second and third marginal teeth narrower than that between the first and second; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the posterior edge of the first longer than the anterior edge. Sides of the labrum converging anteriorly into an obtuse point. Pronotum narrower than the head, transversely arched, anterior margin raised and distinctly serrate, posterolateral corners broadly rounded, flattened in some specimens. Femora not swollen. Measurements (mm; range/mean/holotype of 8 soldiers): head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.62—1.71/1.67/1.71; maximum head width 1.37—1.43/1.40/1.40; maximum head height 1.22/1.22/1.22; left mandible length 0.70—0.73/0.73/0.73; maximum postmentum width 0.46—0.49/—/0.49; minimum postmentum width 0.40—0.46/0.43/0.43; postmentum length 0.79—0.85/0.81/0.79; median pronotum length 0.67—0.85/0.78/0.85; maximum pronotum length 0.85—1.00/0.96/0.98; maximum pronotum width 1.28—1.37/1.33/1.28; hind tibia length 0.98—1.10/1.05/1.10.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality Camp Putnam on the bank of the Epulu River, Congo (1°24′ N, 28°36′ E); collected by A. E. Emerson on 1948-04-14 from hard dry wood in a dead standing tree by the river; the same lot includes soldiers (holotype and paratypes) and alates (morphotype and paratypes).
